title.en: An Act to Suspend the Operation of Act Numbered Twenty-Seven Hundred and Ninety-three, Known as the Patent Law, Until Such Time as By Law It Shall Be Declared to Be in Effect, and for Other Purposes

text.en:
Section twenty-three of Act Numbered Twenty-seven hundred and ninety-three, known as the
Patent Law, as amended by Act Numbered Twenty-nine hundred and four, is hereby further amended to read
"Section 23. The operation of the present Act is hereby suspended until such time as by law it shall again be
declared to be in effect, until which date Act Numbered Twenty-two hundred and thirty-five, entitled 'An Act
providing for the registration of patents and patent rights in the Philippine Islands, and for the protection of the
same,' shall continue in full force and effect."
Approved, March 8, 1922.
